args.title: Fix deduplication for overlapping days in multiple uploads
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Update the deduplication logic to correctly handle overlapping transactions when multiple statements are uploaded together. The current implementation fails to identify duplicates when two consecutive monthly statement uploads have overlapping days, leading to duplicate entries in the ledger. By adjusting the deduplication process to recognize and manage overlaps, we ensure accurate transaction recording.
